AFG00.description: The UN established the Special Trust Fund for Afghanistan in October 2021 to help address basic human needs across the country– in areas ranging from essential services and basic infrastructure to livelihoods, disaster mitigation and response and advocacy for the promotion of human rights and women’s empowerment. Done in tandem with strengthening links to peace and humanitarian action, the Fund serves as an inter-agency mechanism where donors can channel resources to support the United Nations Strategic Framework for Afghanistan. Crowdfunding Campaign for displaced Afghans

JLY00.name: JP Libya Developing Juvenile Justice
JLY00.description: Stakeholders of the Developing Juvenile Justice in Libya Joint Programme work to ensure children have access to a child-friendly justice system that protects their basic rights by embedding functional child right principles in existing practices and addressing gaps in regulatory frameworks.

JXH00.name: JP Pacific Digital Economy Programme
JXH00.description: Although socio-political and corporate influencers have made significant digital infrastructure investments in several Pacific Small Island Developing States, the national governments of Fiji, Tonga, Samoa, Vanuatu, and Solomon Islands raised the bar and set out to increase digital connectivity across the region by 2030. Scaling up the region’s digital economies is a transformative measure that will affect millions, reach vulnerable communities, and enhance women’s access to basic services—particularly with COVID-19 recovery efforts. Increased investments in core digital infrastructure and adjacent devices, tools, and platforms accelerate SDG achievement by financing innovative and contextually sound solutions. Development approaches identify the root causes of market dysfunction and address constraints by narrowing the digital divide, involving rural communities and micro, small, and medium business owners in launching targeted solutions, strengthening relationships between market actors, and rolling out inclusive digital strategies and tools.

AL200.name: Albania SDG Fund II
AL200.description: Emerging from the ‘Delivering as One’ pilot of 2007, the Albania SDG Acceleration Fund advances the 2030 Agenda by driving progress towards Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) achievement while respecting human rights, promoting gender equality and women’s empowerment, and using similar crosscutting issues to multiply sustainable and inclusive economic growth, poverty eradication, and social development. Between 2015 and 2021, stakeholders received blended forms of financing to design programmes in line with 2030 Agenda mandate requirements focused on collective and integrated action across multiple sectors and goals. Continued efforts are being made to meet outstanding targets and unmet goals. The Acceleration Fund will enter its second phase of implementation in January 2022, with large contributions expected under the banners of ‘leave no one behind’, social protection, and inclusion.

BHP00.name: Nature4Health
BHP00.description: The Biodiversity for Health and Pandemic Prevention MPTF relies on partnerships, tested approaches, integrated policies, capacity development across sectors, and evidence-based action on the ground to endorse and foster “One Health” approaches. The One Health model takes environmental components and incorporates them into existing or nascent development and humanitarian action with the aim of preventing future pandemics and forging sustainable and effective cross-sector collaboration.

CRA00.name: Complex Risk Analytics Fund
CRA00.description: Underlying the Complex Risk Analytics Fund (CRAF’d) is an integrated ecosystem approach for improving action-focused data collaboration. CRAF’d investments close data gaps, improve data capacities and standards, and strengthen the quality of data-derived insights, translating risk information into effective crisis action that better aligns anticipatory, prevention, and recovery responses to complex risks in fragile and crisis-affected settings.

DER00.name: UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration
DER00.description: Empowering stakeholders to prevent, halt, and reverse the degradation of global ecosystems. The UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration MPTF focuses on the conservation and restoration of terrestrial, freshwater, and marine ecosystems to achieve all restoration-related targets laid out in environmental global processes. Fund stakeholders design and implement policies, projects, and practices that combat declining biodiversity, support livelihoods, and enhance natural resource bases to help people around the world adapt to, and mitigate, climate change.

JBF00.name: JP Burkina Faso RoL and Terrorism
JBF00.description: Strengthening rule of law and improving security crisis management in Burkina Faso. Aligned with national and international security approaches, stakeholders of the Burkina Faso Rule of Law and Terrorism Joint Programme address security and stability concerns in the Sahel. By strengthening management capacities of government and security authorities in Burkina Faso, partners advance terrorism-related investigation processes that effectively lead to the prosecution of terrorism-related cases in accordance with international human rights standards.

JKS20.name: JP Healthier Kosovo II
JKS20.description: Building on the success of earlier projects, partners of the Healthier Kosovo II Joint Programme bring together disparate threats and offer innovative solutions under the umbrellas of public health, environmental sustainability, and institutional capacity development. Stakeholders focus on reducing environmental and disease burdens of the population with programme measures that foster outcomes, which boost national health indicators and help people transition towards a resilient society. Solutions proposed under the joint programme are SDG-driven and inclusive means of addressing air pollution, COVID-19 stressors, state of healthcare facilities, and ways to curb negative effects of climate change on health and well-being in the country.

JXG00.name: Pacific Insurance and Climate Adaptation Programme (PICAP)
JXG00.description: To assist the governments, private sector partners, and local populations of Pacific Small Island Developing States better manage economic loss following natural and climate change-related disasters, stakeholders set out to improve disaster risk management plans and link them to newly developed national and sub-national integrated climate disaster risk financing (CDRF) strategies. CDRF tools and instruments, like parametric insurance, are a new medium for reaching low-income people and those left behind—vulnerable populations comprising women, youth, and individuals employed in micro, small, and medium enterprises from the agriculture, fisheries, and tourism sectors.

JLR20.name: JP Community-Based Forestry and Protected Area Management in Liberia
JLR20.description: Harnessing the full capacities of the United Nations in Liberia, Community-Based Forestry and Protected Area Management (CFPM) Joint Programme stakeholders strengthen management practices linked to community forests and protected areas in Liberia.

JMG10.name: JP Early Warning Anticipatory System in Madagascar
JMG10.description: The Early Warning System and Anticipatory Actions Joint Programme in Madagascar brings together local communities, institutions and partners to design and pilot robust, tailored and sustainable mechanisms for better anticipating, preparing and responding to droughts in the Great South region of the country.

BDI00.name: Burundi Multi-Partner Trust Fund
BDI00.description: To strengthen joint action around socio-economic indicators, Burundi SDG MPTF stakeholders implement initiatives that secure results for national framework objectives. Country programme priorities are addressed via short-cycle projects to meet the needs of the most disadvantaged and marginalized, and help raise community resilience in the face of humanitarian and development shocks.

JBD60.name: JP Bangladesh SAFE II
JBD60.description: The second phase of the Safe Access to Fuel and Energy (SAFE+) joint project links three strategic priorities. By providing access to cleaner energy and efficient cooking fuel, increasing environmental conservation and rehabilitation, and raising community resilience, stakeholders create space for Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh to adopt adaptive coping strategies and improve social relationships between refugee and host communities.

JYE30.name: Supporting Resilient Livelihoods, Food Security and Climate Adaptation In Yemen (ERRY III)
JYE30.description: Building on outcomes and progress from earlier phases of the joint programme, the Supporting Resilient Livelihoods, Food Security and Climate Adaptation in Yemen Joint Programme (ERRY III) enhances community capacities to respond to, and reduce, vulnerabilities caused by the ongoing and complex crisis In Yemen. Also addressed are poverty, socio-economic and gender inequality, and environmental pressures that exacerbate instability across the country.

SOF00.name: Systematic Observations Financing Facility
SOF00.description: The Systematic Observations Financing Facility (SOFF) addresses missing weather and climate observations around the world. The mechanism supports and accelerates the collection and international exchange of highly essential surface-based weather and climate observations in compliance with international standards to improve the quality and provision of weather forecasts, early warning systems, and climate services at all levels of society.

UZB00.name: Uzbekistan Vision 2030 Fund
UZB00.description: The Uzbekistan Vision 2030 Fund is an UN inter-agency pooled fund that aims at achieving the Sustainable Development Goals in Uzbekistan by 2030. It is anchored in the UN Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework 2021-25 (UNSDCF) and its successors. The UNSDCF was developed through participatory and inclusive consultations with national stakeholders, UN entities, contributors, IFIs and other development partners. Any successor UNSDCF would undergo the same level of rigorous consultation. Further to the Agreement between the Swiss Confederation and the Republic of Uzbekistan on the Modalities for the Return of Illegally Acquired Assets Forfeited in the Swiss Confederation to the Benefit of the Population of the Republic of Uzbekistan, the Fund is capitalized through a contribution representing a return of assets that have been definitively forfeited in criminal proceedings in Switzerland. The Fund will support principled, transparent, and effective asset restitution via programs aimed at accelerating the Government of Uzbekistan’s national reform agenda and the SDGs.

DHE00.name: Decarbonizing Humanitarian Energy Multi-Partner Trust Fund
DHE00.description: Propelled by a consortium of leading organizations and stakeholders, the Decarbonizing Humanitarian Multi-Partner Trust Fund facilitates the piloting of a Centralized Clean Energy Service (CCES) fit for humanitarian and fragile settings.

HTI00.name: Haiti Multi-Partner Trust Fund
HTI00.description: Leveraging the national Integrated Recovery Plan for the Southern Peninsula, Haiti MPTF stakeholders respond to critical recovery needs from the August 2021 earthquake. Integrated and multi-sector action progresses economic and governance recovery, resilient infrastructure, land use planning, and inclusive social protection measures.

JGE60.name: Joint Programme for Gender Equality in Georgia III
JGE60.description: The third phase of the UN Joint Programme for Gender Equality (UNJP4GE) applies comprehensive and inclusive solutions to bridge existing social, political, and economic gender inequality gaps in Georgia and the conflict-affected region of Abkhazia.

JPH20.name: Conflict Transformation in BARMM
JPH20.description: Leveraging the United Nations Socio-economic and Peacebuilding Framework for COVID-19 Recovery (2020-2023) alongside national and regional development plans is how stakeholders of the Conflict Transformation in BARMM, in the Philippines, counter the deceleration of socio-economic growth, weakened social cohesion, and upticks in violence in Bangsamoro. Transformation is sought by strengthening community resilience and social cohesion in high-risk areas and forging lasting peace dividends.

MD200.name: Moldova 2030 Partnerships Fund Phase II
MD200.description: The second phase of the Moldova 2030 SDGs Partnerships Fund Acceleration Fund is innovative instrument for accelerating implementation of the 2030 Agenda and SDG achievement, and to support the European Union accession process.

TZ200.name: Tanzania SDG Fund
TZ200.description: Aligned with the national UNSDCF, Tanzania SDG Fund stakeholders address socioeconomic development challenges through the windows of human rights and gender equality, social resilience, leaving no one behind, socioeconomic and environmental sustainability, and institutional accountability.

DIG00.name: Digital Cooperation Fund
DIG00.description: To spread the benefits of technology safely in an era of rapid technological change, multistakeholder collective action across borders is urgently needed. Such global digital cooperation includes concerted efforts to align governance with human rights on such technologies as digital public infrastructure or artificial intelligence. It includes pooling capacities and data to develop better algorithms that address societal challenges. It includes catalysing learning across borders for enhanced human capacity and turbocharging digital transformations. The Digital Cooperation Fund is set up as a multi-partner trust fund with six Funding Windows (or “Pillars”), and for which additional Pillars will be defined at a later stage.

IDS00.name: The Internal Displacement Solutions Fund (IDSF)
IDS00.description: In response to an appeal from Member States, the UN Secretary-General set up a High-Level Panel on Internal Displacement. Based on the Panel’s report, the SG launched an Action Agenda on Internal Displacement in 2022, setting out a common vision for stepped up action to promote solutions to internal displacement, prevent future displacement crises, and ensure protection and assistance to those already internally displaced. The Internal Displacement Solutions Fund (IDSF) supports strategic, collaborative and comprehensive engagement of UNCTs, supporting initiatives addressing internal displacement aligned with national priorities, the 2030 Agenda, and SDG achievement. Investments of the IDSF support cross-sector approaches tailored to local realities, responding to specific barriers IDPs face in each location and opens solutions pathways for IDPs.

JIQ00.name: Reintegration Through Integrated Support and Empowerment (RISE)
JIQ00.description: Reintegration Through Integrated Support and Empowerment (RISE) fund will provide social, economic and mental health reintegration support to conflict-affected communities in Iraq and returnees from Northeast Syria, including women and children, to ensure human dignity, improve social cohesion, and community reconciliation.

JRS10.name: JP Serbia EVEC
JRS10.description: Ending Violence and Empowering Change Joint Programme in Serbia stakeholders establish a gender-responsive environment that enables women and girls to exercise their rights and decision-making capacities through whole-of-society and whole-of-systems approaches.

JUG20.name: Spotlight 2.0 Joint Programme Uganda the Gender for Development (G4DU)
JUG20.description: Stakeholders of Spotlight Initiative Joint Programme of the Gender for Development Uganda (G4DU)work to eliminate sexual and gender-based violence against women and girls, violence against children, and harmful practices that prevent them from accessing and continuing their education. Building on past Spotlight Initiative programming addressing gender-based violence in Uganda, the programme continues to work with government and civil society to provide a holistic approach to deliver multi-sectoral interventions. The programme is part of the global Spotlight Initiative umbrella framework of programmes, and of the broader Gender for Development Uganda (GD4U) programme framework.

TUN00.name: MPTF for Employment and Youth in Tunisia
TUN00.description: The Tunisian government and United Nations established the MPTF for Employment and Youth in Tunisia to respond to youth unemployment, implementing solutions to reduce unemployment rates and contribute to the creation of decent jobs to support the aspirations of educated young women and men in the country.

JST00.name: JP Sao Tome
JST00.description: At the Green Infrastructure for Health and Education in São Tomé and Príncipe stakeholders apply inclusive and integrated approaches that improve institutional abilities to implement national health and education infrastructure, as well as multi-sector health and education service delivery with integrated energy and climate-focused components.

UKR00.name: Ukraine Community Recovery Fund
UKR00.description: The Ukraine Community Recovery Fund (UCRF) is a tool for stakeholders to catalyze strategic efforts, bridge gaps in recovery needs in targeted communities, and pilot innovative resilience and recovery initiatives in Ukraine.

IR100.name: One UN Impact Fund for the Islamic Republic of Iran
IR100.description: The One UN Impact Fund aims to support the coherent resource mobilization, allocation and disbursement of donor resources to priorities defined in the framework of the UN Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) 2023-2027 for the Islamisc Republic of Iran. The Fund represents one of the proposed vehicles for new resources pooled by donors and it will operate under the principle of national ownership. The Fund offers the potential to catalyze integrated programming by establishing transformative criteria for joint planning and effective funds allocations from a broader donor base, aligned with the UNSDCF priority needs, including a Humanitarian/Emergency/Disaster response (DR) that might quickly support humanitarian actions in response to sudden onset emergencies.

JXI00.name: Spotlight Initiative High-Impact Programme for Violence Elimination
JXI00.description: Designed to sustain Spotlight Initiative achievements, the High-Impact Programme for Violence Elimination (HIVE) scales investment and reach to implementing effective country/regional programmes and increasing global awareness and knowledge on ending violence against women and girls.

NAF00.name: The Nature Investment Facility
NAF00.description: Designed to deliver strategic results that advance nature-positive development, stakeholders of The Nature Facility unlock investments to drive climate-smart and nature-wise solutions that address the drivers of environmental degradation and ecological instability and improve local community resilience.

GPN00.name: UN Global Pulse Network
GPN00.description: The UN Global Pulse Network promotes responsible and inclusive innovations that serve humanity, foster sustainable development, and safeguard our planet. As a collaborative platform, it supports the United Nations family and its stakeholders to innovate at the intersection of digital and human sciences. Global Pulse contributes to the development of next-generation UN programming and supports the transformation of the United Nations into a “UN 2.0”.

IRF00.name: Infrastructure Resilience Accelerator Fund (IRAF)
IRF00.description: The Infrastructure Resilience Accelerator Fund (IRAF) is a Multi-Partner Trust Fund—established by UNDP, UNDRR, and the Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure—offers customized technical assistance, capacity building, research and knowledge management, and advocacy to countries at all stages of development.

JBA20.name: JP DRR for Sustainable Development in Bosnia and Herzegovina – Phase II
JBA20.description: Stakeholders behind Phase II of the Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) Joint Programme for Sustainable Development in Bosnia and Herzegovina, support the design, application and scaling of ‘all-of-society’, localized and cross-cuttinginterventions that advance holistic disaster risk management and accelerate SDG achievement.

JPS20.name: JP OPT Sawasya III
JPS20.description: Sawasya III applies integrated approaches and measures to promote intersectionality, gender and child justice and leave no one behind. Joint programme stakeholders actively and flexibly leverage their expertise and resources to holistically address access to justice barriers in the occupied Palestinian territory (oPT).

JSY00.name: JP Syria Phase II Urban and Rural Resilience
JSY00.description: The Joint Programme to Strengthen Urban and Rural Resilience and Conditions for Recovery in Syria implements innovative, multi-sector, area-based and collaborative early recovery and resilience building initiatives via a pooled fund mechanism intended to improve access to critical basic services, provide support to livelihoods, and contribute to enhanced social cohesion in conflict-affected areas of the country.

JUA00.name: JP Ukraine CRSV
JUA00.description: Stakeholders of the Ukraine CSRV Joint Programme work through three core workstreams to strengthen coordination and action for survivors of conflict-related sexual violence to have access to quality, comprehensive and multi-sector services and information.

ME200.name: Montenegro SDG Acceleration Fund
ME200.description: The Montenegro Acceleration Fund is an advanced and innovative tool for partners to deliver on “last mile” commitments (social progress, climate change, leave no one behind) for SDG achievement and to support the accession process to the European Union.

MYS00.name: Malaysia-UN SDG Trust Fund
MYS00.description: An initiative of MySDG Foundation and UN in Malaysia, the Malaysia-UN SDG Trust Fund supports catalytic interventions that target those at risk of being left behind. The fund promotes partnerships and a whole-of-society approach to create equitable and inclusive pathways for sustainable development with an emphasis on local action, improved livelihoods and SDG progress in Malaysia.

KBF00.name: Kunming Biodiversity Fund
KBF00.description: The Kunming Biodiversity Fund supports accelerated action to deliver 2030 Agenda and SDG targets and 2050 goals of the Kunming-Montréal Global Biodiversity Framework, particularly in developing countries.

AAA00.name: NBSAP Accelerator Partnership Accelerator Action Account MPTF (NBSAP AP AAA MPTF)
AAA00.description: The NBSAP Accelerator Action Account (AAA) Multi-Partner Trust Fund (MPTF) is established under the framework of the NBSAP Accelerator Partnership (AP). It serves as a strategic last-resort funding mechanism that provides dedicated support for high-priority, quality-assured, developing country-led biodiversity actions identified through the NBSAP AP’s Matchmaking Mechanism (MMM). The AAA supports only critical gaps identified through the MMM, sustaining momentum where other support is not available.

JGE80.name: JP Georgia Human Rights for All Phase 3
JGE80.description: The third phase of JP Human Rights for All tackles human rights challenges, advancing civil, political, economic, and social rights by focusing on vulnerable groups. It prioritizes stronger national human rights frameworks, empowering rights-holders, and bolstering the capacity of civil society organizations and human rights defenders to drive policy reforms in line with international standards and recommendations.

JXJ00.name: Science and Diplomacy Joint Programme
JXJ00.description: The Science and Diplomacy Joint Programme provides financial backing to the Secretary-General’s Scientific Advisory Board (SAB), which aims to strengthen the UN's use of science and technology across its policies and programmes. By providing access to emerging research on critical global issues, the SAB ensures that science is integrated into key decision-making processes across the UN.

PG200.name: Papua New Guinea UN Country Fund II
PG200.description: The Papua New Guinea UN Country Fund II finances action that translated catalytic support into Cooperation Framework outcomes that are aligned with the National Policy Framework and Sustainable Development Goals.

SIT00.name: Spotlight Initiative 2.0 Fund
SIT00.description: Spotlight Initiative invests in programmes that improve the rights and opportunities of women and girls around the world through the prevention of and response to all forms of violence against women and girls. Spotlight Initiative supports comprehensive, whole-of-society and inclusive approaches that enable women and girls to live lives free from the debilitating experience or effects of harmful practices and various forms of violence.

SPE00.name: United Nations Special Programme for Economies of Central Asia - SPECA MPTF
SPE00.description: Designed to accelerate the achievement of strategic, long-term objectives, SPECA stakeholders facilitate economic cooperation in Central Asia by creating incentives for economic development and integration with European, Asian and global economies. The Fund provides a platform for cooperation on transboundary and cross-border issues in support of SDG achievement.

JEC00.name: Spotlight Initiative 2.0 - Joint Programme in Ecuador
JEC00.description: The Spotlight Initiative 2.0: Joint Programme in Ecuador works to eliminate all forms of violence against women and girls, including femicide. The programme works with government and civil society to deliver multi-sector interventions that ensure the Comprehensive Organic Law for the Prevention and Eradication of Violence against Women and legal framework on femicide are implemented in alignment with international human rights instruments.

JGE70.name: JP Support to 2024 Elections in Georgia
JGE70.description: The Joint Programme for the Georgian 2024 parliamentary elections increases voter participation, inclusiveness, accountability and a peaceful civic environment. It promotes the capacity of electoral stakeholders through the engagement of voters, civil society organizations, youth, women, minorities, people living with disabilities and academia.

JXK00.name: JP EU 4 Gender Equality in Wes

MLI00.name: Trust Fund For Stabilization and Resilience in Mali (SRM Fund)

JSO20.name: UN Joint Rule of Law Programme for Somaliland Phase II
JSO20.description: The Programme is designed to enhance institutional capacity for effective and efficient service delivery for improving oversight, accountability and transparency by advocating legal and policy framework to be put in place for gender justice and human rights and enhancing criminal justice enforcement and correctional services.

JSO30.name: JP Somalia UN Joint Police Programme - Phase II
JSO30.description: The second phase of JPP II targets community and institutional engagement, working with Somalia’s Ministry of Interior, National Police, and Internal Security to build capacity and restore trust. JPP II enhances police efficiency, transparency, and accountability while strengthening federal and state security institutions with a focus on human rights and gender-responsive measures.

NCD00.name: NCD MPTF (Health4Life Fund)
NCD00.description: Stakeholders of the Health4Life Fund work towards catalyzing action for non-communicable diseases (NCDs) and mental health (MPTF). Collective action leverages existing and/or proven cost-effective solutions that are country-led, catalytic, multi-sector, equity-driven, and impact oriented, helping translate policies into action for visible, measurable results on mental health and NCDs.

NP100.name: Nepal SDCF Fund
NP100.description: The Nepal Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework Fund is accessible to members of the UN Country Team in Nepal to carry out joint efforts as outlined in the United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) and national development plans. The framework comprises four priority areas.

BRA00.name: Brazilian Legal Amazon MPTF
BRA00.description: Stakeholders of the Multi-Partner Trust Fund for the Sustainable Development of the Brazilian Legal Amazon work on strengthening governance and institutional capacities to promote territorial development that respects natural systems and community needs, and builds the resilience of local, vulnerable populations.

GEO00.name: UN Georgia Thematic Pooled Fund – Civic Space
GEO00.description: The UN Georgia Thematic Pooled Fund – Civic Space supports inclusive participation, community engagement, and locally led development across Georgia. Through joint UN programmes, the Fund strengthens opportunities for dialogue, collaboration, and community-driven solutions, contributing to the Sustainable Development Goals and the United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework.

JGE90.name: JP Green, Inclusive and Circular Economy
JGE90.description: The NDICI-GEO-ENEST/2025/485-004 Joint Programme, titled “Green, Inclusive and Circular Economy: Waste Reduction and Recycling for Citizen’s Health”, invests €4 million from the EU to enhance circular economy practices in Georgia by strengthening EPR systems, building stakeholder capacity, and expanding recycling infrastructure.

JLA30.name: JP Lao PDR on Green and Climate Finance

CAF00.name: CAR Sustainable Development Fund (Emai Fund)
CAF00.description: The CAR Sustainable Development Fund (Emai Fund) is a country-level pooled fund established by the Government of the Central African Republic and the United Nations to accelerate implementation of the National Development Plan (PND 2024-2028) and the UN Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF 2023-2029). It finances catalytic joint programmes that promote peace, inclusive social services, sustainable growth, and climate resilience through community-driven, integrated approaches.

CAL00.name: The Cali Fund
CAL00.description: The Cali Fund is the first of its kind to rely on the private sector as principal contributors for their use of Digital Sequence Information, and therefore reliance on data from nature. It will support eligible Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity and indigenous peoples and local communities in the implementation of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework to halt and reverse the loss of biodiversity by 2030. For potential contributors, please download this set of documents and submit the filled in forms to mptfo@undp.org Contribution letter and forms

CFS00.name: UN MPTF for Catalytic Finance in Sanitation, Hygiene and Wastewater
CFS00.description: The Multi-Partner Trust Fund for Catalytic Finance in Sanitation, Hygiene, and Wastewater is the first trust fund focused on SDG target 6.2 by addressing underfunded sectors like sanitation, hygiene, menstrual health, and wastewater. Using market-based approaches, partners unite public and private sectors to create an environment where investments are incentivized and deliver greater impact for people, economies, and the planet.

JRS20.name: Strengthening Migration Governance and Asylum Systems in Serbia - Enhancing policies, Protecting Rights

JXL00.name: UN Futures Lab Network Joint Programme
JXL00.description: The UN Futures Lab was established by the Executive Office of the Secretary-General in 2023. It is a global network that empowers the UN system and beyond to use futures thinking and strategic foresight in planning, policymaking, and decision-making. The UN Futures Lab is driven by a Global Hub which supports teams, provide tools, and builds capacity to help shape a more resilient and anticipatory UN.
